$description: This is the exact shape of the JSON that ai_pipeline/main.py's run_pipeline() returns, and that api_server.py's /process-document endpoint responds with (wrapped in {ok, data}). Frontend and backend teammates should build against this contract.

document_type.description: One of: prescription | lab_report | discharge_summary | unknown. Only reliably populated when the LLM structuring path runs (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set) — the rule-based fallback always returns 'unknown'.

date.description: Date found on the document, as extracted (not normalized to a fixed format).

diagnoses.description: Lines/phrases identified as diagnosis or chief-complaint mentions.

medicines.description: name is always populated. dosage/frequency are only reliably split out on the LLM path — the rule-based fallback puts the whole matched line in 'name' and leaves dosage/frequency null.

lab_values.description: flag is null when no reference range could be found either in the document text or the internal fallback table.

source.description: 'llm' or 'rule_based' — tells you which extraction path actually produced this result. Useful for debugging accuracy issues.

raw_text_preview.description: First ~400 characters of the cleaned OCR text, for a raw-text fallback view on the frontend and for debugging.
